record_scope_reconstruction: Canawaima operator notice suspends Guyana–Suriname ferry service from March 14 2020. Guyana government reports February 21 first resumption with sixteen passengers, only Guyanese/Surinamese nationals, and use of Sandaka while Canawaima was maintained.

source_checks.finding: Operator statement reproduced in full establishes March 14 service suspension.
Government body reports actual Sunday passage, Moleson Creek facilities, restricted national eligibility and substitute vessel.

sites.name: Moleson Creek–South Drain ferry (Moleson control)

Its country label is unreliable, so it is used as a terminal-area reference only.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: International ferry service at Moleson Creek–South Drain, not an arbitrary Corentyne river point.
phase_decisions.date_scope_check: March 14–February 21 retained; limited nationals endpoint not universal reopening.
